correctness.rationale: Two exact face characterizations agree on all 262144 subsets. Both deterministic matchings are genuine matchings; both exhaustive 900162-cover directed posets topologically sort all 118562 nodes, proving acyclicity. Integral oriented unit-pivot Morse elimination yields the verified zero 9-to-8 differential for the four-critical-cell matching. Forman and Hurewicz imply the nine-cell attaching map is null and establish the full sphere wedge. Independent second matching produces primitive rank-one integral differential.

value.rationale: The 18-vertex cubic Pappus incidence graph is a natural finite-geometric object and its dominance complex captures dominating sets. The nonpure 118562-face simplicial complex has a nontrivial mixed-dimensional homotopy type that is not a routine Euler-characteristic consequence, supplying an exact benchmark beyond the established forest/chordal cases.
